n9_operations.validate_incoming_observation_contract: Checks that every patch has one permitted evidence source, a usable identifier and valid confidence metadata. Invalid input is rejected rather than silently reinterpreted.
n9_operations.identify_input_pathway_and_script_profil: Identifies whether evidence arrives as an image, N2 representation, feature vector or grapheme probabilities, and reads the declared script and reading direction.
n9_operations.preserve_raw_observation_and_source_iden: Builds a stable digest from the sequence, source and patch evidence so later results can be linked to this observation without copying image pixels into the log.
n9_operations.construct_missing_data_and_occlusion_mas: Creates a mask showing which parts of each patch are observed, allowing reliability estimates to distinguish visible evidence from missing or occluded regions.
n9_operations.establish_spatial_and_temporal_coordinat: Creates normalized position coordinates while preserving caller order, so downstream stages can reason about where evidence belongs.
n9_operations.estimate_initial_observation_reliability: Combines segmentation confidence with visible fraction to estimate how dependable each patch is as sensory evidence.
n9_operations.initialize_separated_latent_state: Creates separate storage channels for visual, orthographic, lexical, phonological, syntactic, semantic and contextual information instead of collapsing them into one value.
n9_operations.validate_upstream_module_contract_compat: Checks which adapters are connected and whether a configured N3 model is fitted before attempting to use it.
n9_operations.snapshot_read_only_model_resources: Fingerprints connected model resources before inference so unintended changes to read-only models can be detected.
n9_operations.encode_task_and_operating_mode: Records the requested task and whether learning has been explicitly authorized. Recognition and learning remain separate decisions.
n9_operations.load_context_and_working_memory_snapshot: Copies supplied context into a run-specific snapshot so this run uses a stable view of the caller's context.
n9_operations.build_dependency_graph_and_schedule_bran: Defines how visual, orthographic, attention, lexical, syntax, semantic, discourse, feedback, decision and learning stages depend on each other.
n9_operations.convert_or_retrieve_luminance_and_ink_si: Measures basic brightness statistics for image patches when pixels are supplied. Without image data, this operation is marked not applicable.
n9_operations.compute_local_center_surround_contrast: Retrieves N1 ON/OFF center-surround responses when N1 image processing was run. These channels emphasize local brightness increases and decreases.
n9_operations.normalize_local_contrast: Retrieves normalized N1 feature maps when available so local visual responses can be compared on a controlled scale.
n9_operations.extract_orientation_selective_energy: Retrieves orientation-sensitive N1 energy maps when available. These represent evidence for edges, bars and other oriented patterns.
n9_operations.separate_spatial_frequency_bands: Retrieves N2 multiscale representations when present, preserving visual structure at different spatial scales.
n9_operations.detect_edge_contour_and_junction_evidenc: Retrieves N2 contour evidence when available, which can help describe boundaries and junction-like structures.
n9_operations.pool_local_features_into_shape_descripto: Builds or copies a compact descriptor for each patch from available N2 or caller-provided features. Missing feature sources receive an explicit neutral placeholder.
n9_operations.construct_visual_population_features: Stores the selected descriptor source for each patch and records whether it came from N2, caller features or probability-only input.
n9_operations.retain_alternative_region_segmentation_h: Keeps caller-localized patch boundaries as explicit hypotheses. It records that automatic segmentation was not performed.
n9_operations.estimate_figure_ground_and_stroke_groupi: Computes pairwise spatial grouping strengths from patch coordinates. This is a simple grouping proxy, not a full figure-ground or stroke-segmentation system.
n9_operations.align_visual_fragments_with_candidate_re: Associates each localized patch with its feature availability and region index so later candidate evidence remains aligned to its source.
n9_operations.emit_n2_visual_evidence_package: Marks which evidence channels are available for the next stage, including raw observations, N1 visual outputs, N2 structure and caller-supplied grapheme probabilities.
n9_operations.create_script_specific_grapheme_vocabula: Builds the active symbol vocabulary from supplied probability labels or a fitted N3 model. If neither exists, it creates an explicit unknown-only fallback.
n9_operations.compute_distributed_grapheme_activations: Creates or retrieves a probability distribution over grapheme classes for every patch. Rows remain aligned with the original patch sequence.
n9_operations.estimate_novelty_and_unknown_probability: Measures probability assigned to an explicit unknown class, when that class exists in the vocabulary.
n9_operations.build_absolute_position_code: Creates an identity-like position matrix indicating each patch's absolute location in the current sequence.
n9_operations.build_relative_position_code: Computes pairwise relative horizontal offsets so the system can represent how patches are positioned with respect to one another.
n9_operations.compute_position_overlap_and_competition: Normalizes patch descriptors and compares them pairwise to estimate feature overlap or similarity.
n9_operations.preserve_identity_and_position_channels: Keeps grapheme probabilities and position codes as separate channels so location does not overwrite symbol identity.
n9_operations.establish_script_aware_logical_order: Uses the declared reading direction while preserving caller-provided logical patch order; it does not reorder patches without explicit evidence.
n9_operations.load_read_only_transition_memory: Checks whether a fitted N3 transition model is available and records its fingerprint when present. No transition memory is invented when absent.
n9_operations.generate_top_k_sequence_candidate_paths: Expands strong grapheme alternatives into a bounded beam of candidate sequences, limiting paths to the configured beam width.
n9_operations.align_sequence_candidates_with_word_boun: Uses caller-provided word spans when available and adds single-patch spans for uncovered positions so every patch remains represented.
n9_operations.decompose_visual_and_contextual_evidence: Packages visual probabilities, position codes and transition-model availability as distinct evidence sources for later inference.
n9_operations.measure_grapheme_entropy: Calculates distribution entropy at each position. A flatter distribution means the system is less certain about which grapheme is present.
n9_operations.measure_orthographic_prediction_error: Uses N3 classwise prediction error when available; otherwise it uses grapheme uncertainty as a conservative error proxy.
n9_operations.derive_task_and_goal_salience: Combines normalized uncertainty, prediction error and supplied task relevance to estimate which positions deserve more processing.
n9_operations.construct_attention_logits: Adds bottom-up salience and task relevance into position-wise scores before competitive attention is allocated.
n9_operations.allocate_competitive_attention: Applies softmax across positions so attention is distributed competitively rather than assigning every position the same unconstrained weight.
n9_operations.smooth_and_floor_attention: Blends attention with a uniform component and smooths neighboring positions, preventing a single location from receiving all resources.
n9_operations.estimate_sensory_precision: Uses observation reliability and allocated attention to estimate how strongly sensory evidence should influence later belief updates.
n9_operations.estimate_prior_precision: Estimates the strength of prior predictions. When N4 is available its output is used; otherwise N9 computes a bounded fallback.
n9_operations.compute_relative_precision_weights: Compares sensory precision with prior precision to show which evidence channel should have greater influence at each position.
n9_operations.form_precision_weighted_error_signals: Builds class-selective gates from prediction errors, scaling mismatch signals by the relevant precision estimates.
n9_operations.pass_attention_metadata_to_downstream_mo: Packages attention and precision values for downstream adapters without changing the preserved visual probability channel.
n9_operations.prepare_feedback_triggered_attention_rea: Stores attention state needed for later feedback analysis. This implementation prepares metadata; it does not run an eye-movement controller.
n9_operations.initialize_recurrent_sequence_beliefs: Starts sequence inference from attended grapheme probabilities, normalizing each position into a probability distribution.
n9_operations.generate_forward_sequence_predictions: Uses learned forward transition statistics to predict the next symbol from the preceding position when a transition model is available.
n9_operations.generate_backward_sequence_predictions: Uses learned reverse transition statistics to predict a symbol from the following position when a transition model is available.
n9_operations.combine_visual_and_bidirectional_predict: Combines forward and backward expectations into a contextual sequence prior and reconciles it with visual evidence using precision-weighted scores.
n9_operations.invoke_n6_lexical_access_adapter: Calls the configured N6 lexical adapter with grapheme probabilities, patch IDs, word spans and context. Without it, N9 uses a surface-form fallback.
n9_operations.retrieve_morphological_hypotheses: Reads stem, affix or other morphology alternatives returned by N6. Missing adapter evidence is reported as not configured.
n9_operations.retrieve_phonological_form_hypotheses: Reads pronunciation or phonological-form alternatives returned by N6 when available; it does not invent pronunciations.
n9_operations.combine_lexical_and_phonological_routes: Keeps the visual route and any adapter-provided lexical route identifiable while packaging word, morphology and phonology candidates.
n9_operations.rank_word_and_sense_candidates: Sorts lexical hypotheses by their supplied scores so the strongest supported candidate is considered first.
n9_operations.apply_lexical_abstention_rule: Compares the best lexical score with the configured confidence threshold and marks the result for abstention when evidence is too weak.
n9_operations.refine_word_boundary_alignment: Retains the word-span alignment used for lexical resolution so candidate words remain tied to their source patches.
n9_operations.emit_n6_interface_package: Marks the lexical interface output as ready, including lexical alternatives and the status of optional morphology and phonology fields.
n9_operations.extract_part_of_speech_and_morphosyntact: Reads grammatical-category and morphosyntactic evidence from the lexical adapter when such evidence has been supplied.
n9_operations.construct_syntactic_hypotheses: Prepares candidate grammatical structures from lexical hypotheses and any part-of-speech features.
n9_operations.load_explicit_grammar_constraints: Loads only grammar rules explicitly supplied in context. It does not assume an undocumented grammar.
n9_operations.invoke_syntax_parser_adapter: Calls the configured syntax parser with lexical candidates, grammatical features, grammar constraints and context.
n9_operations.assign_supported_thematic_roles: Reads agent, patient and other thematic-role assignments only when the syntax output provides them.
n9_operations.compose_hierarchical_phrase_representati: Reads phrase-level structures from the parser so words can be grouped into larger grammatical units.
n9_operations.resolve_explicit_negation_modality_and_q: Reads scope information for negation, modality and quantifiers when the parser supplies it; missing evidence remains unavailable.
n9_operations.represent_connective_and_discourse_relat: Reads explicit connective and discourse-relation outputs rather than guessing relations that were not supplied.
n9_operations.resolve_coreference_only_with_evidence: Accepts coreference links only from configured parser output, avoiding unsupported assumptions about which entities refer to one another.
n9_operations.construct_predicate_argument_proposition: Reads propositions from the semantic adapter or lexical interface when available, preserving the distinction between sentence form and meaning.
n9_operations.construct_and_validate_typed_semantic_gr: Obtains a semantic graph from the configured adapter and checks its node and edge structure against the expected contract.
n9_operations.measure_semantic_completeness_and_ambigu: Records adapter-provided completeness and ambiguity estimates. Without semantic composition, completeness stays low and ambiguity stays high.
n9_operations.load_discourse_context: Selects supplied prior-turn, document, domain and topic context fields for this run.
n9_operations.retrieve_read_only_semantic_memory: Reads the semantic-memory snapshot supplied by the caller. This step does not update the memory.
n9_operations.retrieve_explicit_episodic_document_cont: Reads explicitly supplied episodic or document context and records whether it is available.
n9_operations.invoke_n7_intent_and_domain_adapter: Calls the configured N7 context adapter to obtain intent, domain, predictions and situation-model information.
n9_operations.measure_proposition_context_compatibilit: Reads compatibility scores between propositions and current context when the adapter provides them.
n9_operations.generate_context_conditioned_upcoming_pr: Reads context-conditioned predictions from N7. The controller does not fabricate likely next words when the adapter is absent.
n9_operations.link_temporal_and_causal_relations: Collects temporal and causal links supplied by the context adapter.
n9_operations.construct_situation_model: Stores the situation-model representation returned by N7 when one is available.
n9_operations.measure_discourse_coherence: Records the context adapter's discourse-coherence score, or a neutral default when no adapter is connected.
n9_operations.detect_world_knowledge_conflicts: Collects explicit knowledge-conflict reports from the context adapter; it does not independently verify world facts.
n9_operations.quantify_contextual_uncertainty: Clips the context adapter's uncertainty estimate to a valid range and records it for confidence calibration.
n9_operations.emit_contextual_state_snapshot: Packages selected context, intent, predictions and situation information for feedback and final integration.
n9_operations.generate_hierarchical_top_down_predictio: Collects lexical predictions from context and semantic adapters to form higher-level feedback signals.
n9_operations.project_semantic_predictions_to_lexical_: Maps adapter-provided semantic or lexical predictions onto the known grapheme vocabulary where symbols match.
n9_operations.project_lexical_predictions_to_grapheme_: Projects lexical word-form hypotheses back onto individual grapheme positions, weighted by each candidate's score.
n9_operations.request_predicted_visual_feature_evidenc: Reads predicted visual-feature evidence from the semantic adapter when supplied; otherwise this feedback channel remains unavailable.
n9_operations.compute_level_specific_prediction_errors: Measures differences between visual probabilities and the current proposal, and separately tracks lexical-feedback mismatch.
n9_operations.compute_precision_weighted_prediction_er: Scales visual and lexical mismatch signals by their respective precision estimates.
n9_operations.evaluate_global_free_energy_proxy: Computes a free-energy-inspired objective from visual fit and divergence from the bidirectional prior. It is a computational proxy, not a measured brain quantity.
n9_operations.perform_bounded_posterior_revision: Repeatedly updates posterior probabilities using visual, lexical-feedback and contextual terms, with damping and a maximum iteration count.
n9_operations.detect_cross_channel_conflicts: Measures disagreement between preserved visual probabilities and the revised posterior using Jensen–Shannon divergence.
n9_operations.schedule_targeted_visual_reprocessing: Identifies positions with high uncertainty or error for possible reinspection. The current implementation records indices; it does not automatically rerun image processing.
n9_operations.measure_feedback_convergence: Checks whether successive posterior updates became sufficiently small before the iteration limit was reached.
n9_operations.preserve_channel_specific_evidence: Stores visual, orthographic, posterior and contextual-prior distributions separately so feedback cannot erase the original evidence.
n9_operations.integrate_orthographic_lexical_syntactic: Combines available sequence, lexical, syntax, semantic and context structures into one integrated representation.
n9_operations.construct_joint_candidate_hypotheses: Builds joint candidates by attaching available semantic and contextual support to each leading lexical hypothesis.
n9_operations.evaluate_cross_level_consistency: Combines syntax, semantic-completeness and discourse-coherence evidence into a cross-level consistency estimate.
n9_operations.aggregate_candidate_evidence_and_conflic: Collects support from visual, attended, lexical, semantic and contextual channels for the final decision.
n9_operations.calibrate_level_specific_confidence: Combines posterior confidence, lexical confidence and contextual uncertainty into a bounded confidence estimate and candidate margin.
n9_operations.choose_answer_ambiguous_or_abstain: Chooses a candidate only when confidence and ambiguity gates permit it; otherwise the result is explicitly AMBIGUOUS or ABSTAIN.
n9_operations.build_structured_integrated_result: Builds the machine-readable result containing the decision and ranked grapheme alternatives for each source patch.
n9_operations.build_task_specific_output_representatio: Creates task-facing output fields, such as recognized text for reading or transcription tasks, while retaining decision status.
n9_operations.generate_evidence_linked_explanations: Collects evidence sources, adapter usage, warnings and limitations that explain how the decision was reached.
n9_operations.rollback_invalid_or_unsupported_revision: Checks posterior integrity and, under strict mode, restores preserved visual probabilities and abstains if the revised state is invalid.
n9_operations.estimate_resource_and_computational_cost: Records run-size indicators such as patch count, class count, feature count, feedback iterations and elapsed time.
n9_operations.run_final_integrity_and_provenance_check: Verifies finite probabilities, normalized rows and normalized attention before allowing the result to be returned.
n9_operations.freeze_inference_state_before_learning: Hashes the inference result before considering learning, creating a boundary between recognition and model modification.
n9_operations.detect_candidate_learning_opportunities: Identifies uncertain, unknown or conflicting positions that could be reviewed as possible learning examples.
n9_operations.require_explicit_learning_authorization: Checks the request's explicit learning-authorization flag. No update is permitted merely because an input was recognized.
n9_operations.propose_update_on_detached_child_model: When authorized and N5 exists, deep-copies the adapter and proposes an update on that detached copy. The parent model is checked for mutation.
n9_operations.estimate_transition_statistics_without_m: Counts adjacent symbol pairs in candidate paths as reviewable statistics without directly changing the active transition model.
n9_operations.identify_repeated_patterns_for_mdl_revie: Finds repeated transition patterns that may merit minimum-description-length review; promotion still requires review.
n9_operations.apply_homeostatic_and_anti_forgetting_co: Records regularization and stability conditions for a proposed learning result; it does not claim to reproduce human biological homeostasis.
n9_operations.record_learning_provenance_and_version: Attaches parent and child model fingerprints and provenance metadata to any learning proposal.
n9_operations.prepare_ablation_and_component_isolation: Records components to isolate or ablate in future experiments to test whether each module contributes useful evidence.
n9_operations.record_real_corpus_validation_requiremen: Records the need for real-corpus, held-out and independent validation rather than treating synthetic software tests as proof of recognition quality.
n9_operations.separate_software_task_and_biological_ac: Keeps software correctness, task performance and biological plausibility as separate acceptance criteria.
n9_operations.finalize_integrated_n9_result: Packages the final N9 result, diagnostics, operation trace, decision and governance information for the caller.
